purpose: Keep organization tenancy, human sponsorship, agent attribution, session capability, and personal-brain selection as independent server-derived identity dimensions.

immutable_dimensions.organization_tenant_id: The organization data boundary. Derived and validated by the server; never selected by a browser, model, job payload, personal rule, or personal-brain scope.
immutable_dimensions.sponsoring_human_id: The verified Joe or Dell identity whose business session sponsored the agent. Null for unattended work; it never replaces the acting agent in attribution.
immutable_dimensions.partner_id: The canonical partner identity corresponding exactly to sponsoring_human_id. It is null when no verified human sponsor exists and cannot be asserted by an agent.
immutable_dimensions.agent_principal_id: The registered actor to which the action is attributed, such as Codex, Claude, Doc, or a service identity.
immutable_dimensions.runtime_principal: The authenticated runtime instance and credential class used for this session. It validates agent_principal_id but does not select a human brain.
immutable_dimensions.session_capability_profile: The server-issued, time-limited capability envelope. Personal rules and sponsorship cannot create, widen, or transfer it.
immutable_dimensions.personal_brain_scope: The verified sponsoring partner's personal rule namespace, joe or dell. Explicit none for authenticated unsponsored/background work; null only when sponsor resolution is missing or ambiguous and a sponsor was expected. Never inferred from agent_principal_id.
immutable_dimensions.personal_brain_version: The exported/store generation or immutable digest used to prove which personal set was loaded.
immutable_dimensions.personal_rule_count: The count for the resolved personal-brain version. Zero is valid for an explicitly resolved Dell brain or an authenticated unsponsored scope none; null is required for missing or ambiguous expected scope.

resolution_order: authenticate runtime_principal and map registered agent_principal_id
derive organization_tenant_id from the authenticated server grant and typed route
resolve sponsoring_human_id and partner_id from verified grant metadata, or mark the session unsponsored
derive personal_brain_scope only from the verified sponsor; never from agent_principal_id, model text, partner argument, job input, browser input, or tenant
resolve connector/store and generated-render versions and counts for the same partner scope
issue the exact session_capability_profile independently of personal rules
emit a visible success, refusal, or identity_scope_unknown result and append the redacted identity audit projection

joe_sponsored_agent.acceptance: A Joe-sponsored Codex or Claude session cannot report success until the Joe connector/store set and generated Joe render resolve to the same version and counts.

dell_sponsored_agent.acceptance: A Dell-sponsored session may report zero Dell-personal only after Dell scope resolves explicitly and connector/store and generated Dell render agree.

loads: task-scoped rules explicitly attached to the registered job
forbidden: capability inheritance from a human session

missing_or_ambiguous_sponsor.message: Personal brain scope is missing or ambiguous; no personal-rule load is claimed.

cross_brain_request.effect: deny without returning rule bodies or foreign personal metadata

connector_render_mismatch.effect: Unknown; name both safe source versions and schedule regeneration or store repair

unregistered_runtime.effect: deny before rule or capability resolution

authority_invariants: Actions remain attributed to agent_principal_id/runtime_principal; sponsoring_human_id is additional provenance and never overwrites the actor.
Personal rules cannot select or change organization_tenant_id, runtime principal, agent principal, role, risk class, capability profile, expiry, environment, or resource scope.
Personal rules cannot silently promote into shared scope; promotion is a distinct human-gated, versioned, audited rule-governance action.
Joe-personal and Dell-personal rules never cross-load; a requested foreign brain is refused even when tenant and agent are otherwise valid.
Unsponsored/background agents cannot claim a sponsoring human and cannot call humanOnly verbs.
Tenant, sponsor, agent, personal-brain scope, and capability are server-derived or server-validated; browser, model, connector argument, and job input cannot widen any dimension.

A personal count of zero is a verified value only for an explicitly resolved Dell brain or authenticated unsponsored scope none; missing or ambiguous expected scope is identity_scope_unknown with null count, never a misleading successful zero.

authoritative_pair: generated compiled-rules render for the same partner brain
source_parity.rule: Both surfaces resolve the same partner brain. A mismatch is visible Unknown and cannot degrade to a successful partial load.
source_parity.known_reproduced_defect: Before repair on 2026-08-11, Joe-sponsored Codex resolved runtime actor codex as the personal scope and returned 143 shared plus 0 codex-personal while the Joe generated render declared 30 active Joe-personal rules.
source_parity.verified_repair: Commit e88299c78bf8df29786e435a91e8b9b94f14da8a and Worker b0067bcd-00e6-4c9c-adeb-eedb22e6e377 returned live 143 shared plus 30 Joe-personal with distinct sponsor and runtime metadata; caller-selected partner was refused.

audit_projection.attribution_rule: actor/agent fields identify the executor; sponsor fields identify the verified human origin when present.

phase0_boundary: This file remains a planning contract and its fixture remains synthetic. A separately authorized narrow current-system repair was deployed and live-verified; no Control Room product route, action broker, Phase 0 artifact, or broader construction was deployed.
